tree.text: “Reserve officer” means a commissioned officer in the Reserve, except an officer excluded by section 3732 of this title or a commissioned warrant officer; and
“discharged” means released from an appointment as a Reserve officer.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsProvisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 770 of this title prior to the complete revision of former chapter 21 of this title by Pub. L. 96–322.
Amendments2018—Pub. L. 115–282, § 118(b), renumbered section 720 of this title as this section. Par. (1). Pub. L. 115–282, § 123(b)(2), substituted “section 3732” for “section 721”.
